src = open('app/public/js/renderer.js').read()

# tame reflectivity across the board (user: "everything is way too reflective")
for old, new in [
    ("m.refl = 0.09;\n    m.spec = 24.0;", "m.refl = 0.035;\n    m.spec = 24.0;"),       # floor
    ("m.refl = 0.42;\n    m.spec = 64.0;", "m.refl = 0.28;\n    m.spec = 64.0;"),         # brushed metal
    ("m.refl = 0.24;\n    m.spec = 48.0;", "m.refl = 0.13;\n    m.spec = 48.0;"),         # dark metal
    # fresnel grazing boost was making every surface a mirror lake at distance
    ("pow(1.0 - max(dot(-rd, h.n), 0.0), 5.0) * m.refl * 0.4;",
     "pow(1.0 - max(dot(-rd, h.n), 0.0), 5.0) * m.refl * 0.15;"),
]:
    assert old in src, old
    src = src.replace(old, new)

# calmer sky: drop the dense second star layer, thin the primary one
old = """  vec3 sd = floor(rd * 220.0);
  float st = step(0.998, hash13(sd)) * smoothstep(0.05, 0.3, rd.y);
  vec3 sd2 = floor(rd * 470.0);
  float st2 = step(0.9993, hash13(sd2)) * smoothstep(0.1, 0.4, rd.y);
  base += vec3(st) * 0.6 + vec3(st2) * vec3(0.5, 0.7, 1.0) * 0.8;"""
new = """  vec3 sd = floor(rd * 220.0);
  float st = step(0.9988, hash13(sd)) * smoothstep(0.1, 0.35, rd.y);
  base += vec3(st) * 0.4;"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)

open('app/public/js/renderer.js', 'w').write(src)
print('renderer patched')
